name: Fire water pipe min diameter
description: Fire water supply pipe diameter shall not be less than DN75
message: Fire water pipe {room_name} diameter {value}m is less than required {threshold}m.

name: Drainage pipe min slope
description: Drainage pipe slope shall not be less than 1%
code_ref: PUB CoP on Sewerage & Sanitary Works
message: Drainage pipe {room_name} slope {value} is less than required {threshold}, prone to ponding.

name: Pipe-to-electrical clearance
description: Fire/drainage pipes shall keep >= 0.3m horizontal clearance from electrical equipment (engineering approx., verify against code)
message: Pipe {room_name} is only {value}m from electrical equipment; required >= {threshold}m.

name: Clear height under duct on escape route
description: Clear headroom below a duct on an escape route shall not be less than 2.2m
message: Duct {room_name} leaves only {value}m clear height; required >= {threshold}m.

name: Drainage branch pipe min diameter
description: Drainage branch pipe diameter shall not be less than the DN32 fixture minimum (diameter from geometry bbox; sloped/vertical runs may read small, verify)
code_ref: PUB CoP on Sewerage & Sanitary Works
message: Drainage pipe {room_name} diameter {value}m is below the minimum branch size {threshold}m.

name: Water supply branch pipe min diameter
description: Water supply branch pipe diameter shall not be less than DN15 (diameter from geometry bbox; verify)
message: Supply pipe {room_name} diameter {value}m is below the minimum branch size {threshold}m.

name: Gas pipe min diameter
description: Internal gas branch pipe diameter shall not be less than DN15
message: Gas pipe {room_name} diameter {value}m is below the minimum branch size {threshold}m.

name: Pipe system type defined
description: Pipes shall be classifiable into a system type (fire/drainage/supply/...); unclassified pipes need review
message: Pipe {room_name} system type could not be classified (unknown); review pipe attributes.

name: Fire hydrant spacing
description: Internal fire hydrant spacing shall not exceed 30m (awaits hydrant_spacing_m field)
message: Fire hydrant spacing {value}m exceeds {threshold}m; additional hydrants required.

name: Drainage stack min diameter
description: Drainage stack diameter shall not be less than DN75 (awaits vertical_drain_diameter_m field)
code_ref: PUB CoP on Sewerage & Sanitary Works
message: Drainage stack diameter {value}m is below minimum {threshold}m.
